title: 第635章 侠女师尊第634章 玄素之道
lines: 晨光入阁时，乌阁里很安静，肥啾早已经不知道躲去了哪里。
很显然，经过昨夜一番严肃的学术实践，它深刻意识到，有些时候，鸟不能太讲义气，尤其不能仗着自己是一只啾，就留在不该留的地方。
榻上，乐临清睡得很香。
她侧蜷在许平秋怀里，乌发散了一枕，几缕发丝贴着雪白脸颊，净白的里衣松松垮垮地裹在身上，系带未系，除了起到一个造型的作用外，可以说什么都没守护住。
不知过了多久，乐临清发出一声含混的鼻音，像是仍在梦里，迷迷糊糊地睁开了下眼。
“早啊，清清娘子。”
许平秋低头看着她温声道。
昨夜的玄素之道，确实很玄。
玄到清清老师明明一开始还很紧张，后来却又认真得不像话，一边红着脸，一边像是要把经书上所有看不懂的地方都问清楚。
不过有一点可以确定。
清清老师很厉害，并没有像陆倾桉那样，动不动就一副要和床榻结为异姓兄弟的模样。
乐临清蹭了蹭，窗外的光晃得人懒洋洋的，她便往旁边拱了拱，额头抵在许平秋肩上，双手也顺势抱住了他的腰，整个人软绵绵地贴上去。
晨光落在她肩颈间，将那一片雪色照得莹润温软。
然后，乐临清金眸眨了眨，又有些疲倦似的闭上，好像随时都会睡回笼觉。
“还睡吗？”
许平秋问。
“不睡啦。”
乐临清嘴上这样说，身体却很诚实，仍旧赖在他怀里没有动，声音也软软糯糯的：“再抱一会儿嘛。”
许平秋便由着她抱着。
片刻后，她终于缓缓清醒了些，有些迷糊的坐了起来，松松垮垮的里衣一下子顺着香肩滑了下去。
许平秋认真欣赏着，乐临清感觉他神情格外认真，不由也跟着他的目光看了看。
呆愣了一会，她才回过神，连忙伸手去拢衣襟：“不，不要看了啦。”
“好，不看。”
许平秋很有礼貌地点头，然后他选择了动手。
温热的掌心覆上来，乐临清立刻清醒了些，连忙按住他的手，神情非常严肃的教导坏学生：“现在是白天了，不能坏坏！”
许平秋若有所思：“原来现在是白天，所以不可以坏坏。”
“嗯嗯。”
“那就是晚上可以坏坏了？”
乐临清被他绕了进去，很心虚地点了点头，随即又觉得哪里不对。
可是她刚睡醒，还有些迷糊，但再坏应该也坏不过昨晚，她索性不再去想，只是抬起脸，眼巴巴地看着许平秋：“饿饿了。”
“昨晚不是吃饱了么？”
许平秋故意逗她。
“是吃饱了呀。”
乐临清下意识点头，点到一半忽然反应过来这话不对味，小脸腾地就红透了，声音也弱了下去：“哎呀，不，不是那个吃饱，是要吃饭饭的那个饿饿啦！”
content_en:
When Chen Guang entered the pavilion, it was very quiet in Wu Pavilion, and Fei Jiu had already hidden somewhere.
Obviously, after some serious academic practice last night, it deeply realized that sometimes, birds cannot be too loyal, especially because they cannot stay in places where they should not stay just because they are a chirp.
On the couch, Le Linqing slept soundly.
She was curled up on her side in Xu Pingqiu's arms, with her black hair scattered across the pillow, and a few strands of hair sticking to her snow-white cheeks. Her pure white inner clothes were loosely wrapped around her body, and the ties were not tied. Apart from serving as a styling function, it could not protect anything.
"Well..."
After an unknown amount of time, Le Linqing made a vague nasal noise, as if he was still in a dream, and opened his eyes in a daze.
"Good morning, Madam Qingqing."
Xu Pingqiu looked down at her and said warmly.
The mysterious way last night was indeed very mysterious.
Teacher Xuan Dao Qingqing was obviously very nervous at first, but then he became extremely serious. While blushing, he seemed to want to ask questions about all the things in the scriptures that he didn't understand.
But one thing is certain.
Teacher Qingqing is very powerful. He is not like Lu Qingyu, who always looks like he wants to become brothers with different surnames.
"Good morning, good morning..."
Le Linqing rubbed herself against him. The light outside the window made her feel lazy, so she leaned to the side, resting her forehead on Xu Pingqiu's shoulder. She also hugged his waist with her hands, and pressed her whole body softly against him.
The morning light fell on her shoulders and neck, illuminating the snowy area and making it moist and soft.
Then, Le Linqing's golden eyes blinked and closed again as if he was tired, as if he would fall asleep at any time.
"Are you still sleeping?"
Xu Pingqiu asked.
"No sleep."
Le Linqing said this, but her body was very honest, still lying in his arms without moving, and her voice was soft and waxy: "Hold her for a little longer."
Xu Pingqiu let her hold him.
After a while, she finally woke up slowly, and sat up in a daze, her loose undershirt suddenly sliding down her shoulders.
Xu Pingqiu admired it carefully. Le Linqing felt that he looked particularly serious and couldn't help but follow his gaze.
After being stunned for a while, she came back to her senses and quickly reached out to close her clothes: "No, don't look at it anymore."
"Okay, don't look."
Xu Pingqiu nodded politely, and then he chose to take action.
When the warm palm came up, Le Linqing immediately woke up. He quickly held down his hand and taught the bad student with a very serious expression: "It's daytime now, don't be bad!"
Xu Pingqiu thought thoughtfully: "It turns out it's daytime now, so you can't do anything bad."
"Yeah."
"So you can break it at night?"
"Hmm...yeah."
Le Linqing was surrounded by him, nodded guiltily, and then felt something was wrong.
But she had just woken up and was still a little confused, but no matter how bad it was, it couldn't be worse than last night. She simply stopped thinking about it, just raised her face and looked at Xu Pingqiu longingly: "I'm hungry."
"Didn't you eat enough last night?"
Xu Pingqiu deliberately teased her.
"I'm full."
Le Linqing nodded subconsciously, but in the middle of the nod he suddenly realized that what he said was not right. His face turned red and his voice weakened: "Oh, no, it's not the one who is full, but the one who wants to eat is hungry!"
